title.label: Product H1 Title
title.notes: Front-load primary buyer keyword + key spec; keep under 70 chars for clean Google & mobile display.

description.label: Product Description
description.notes: Natural, human-readable product copy answering buyer questions (fit, material, use-case, care) with Schema-ready clarity.

bullets.label: Key Highlights
bullets.notes: 3–5 concrete, scannable highlights above the fold.

tags.label: Collection Tags / Keywords
tags.notes: Clean category & filter tags for WooCommerce, Magento, Webflow, Wix, or custom storefronts.

seo_title.label: SEO Meta Title
seo_title.notes: Keep ≤60 chars so Google Search does not truncate your title link.

meta_description.label: SEO Meta Description
meta_description.notes: 70–155 chars summarizing the product and primary benefit to lift search click-through rate.

style_notes: Built for WooCommerce, Magento, BigCommerce, Webflow, Wix, Squarespace, and custom D2C stores. Prioritizes Google Organic Search & Google Shopping clarity, clean URL handles, ≤60c SEO titles, and ≤155c meta descriptions.
